msg: host-gateway is specific to Docker Desktop and is not supported in Rancher Desktop.
fix: Delete the --add-host / extra_hosts entry. Containers reach the host as host.docker.internal or host.rancher-desktop.internal without it.

msg: desktop-linux is the Docker Desktop Docker context; it does not exist under Rancher Desktop.
fix: Use the rancher-desktop Docker context: docker context use rancher-desktop (or DOCKER_CONTEXT=rancher-desktop).

msg: docker-desktop is the Kubernetes context Docker Desktop writes to ~/.kube/config.
fix: Switch to the rancher-desktop Kubernetes context: kubectl config use-context rancher-desktop.

msg: ~/.docker/run/docker.sock is the per-user socket of Docker Desktop.
fix: Point at ~/.rd/docker.sock (the rancher-desktop context), or at /var/run/docker.sock with Rancher Desktop Administrative Access turned on.

msg: kubernetes.docker.internal is the API host name of the Docker Desktop Kubernetes cluster.
fix: Do not hard-code the API host; select the rancher-desktop Kubernetes context and let ~/.kube/config supply the server.

msg: docker.for.mac.* / docker.for.win.* are old Docker Desktop host names.
fix: Use host.docker.internal (or host.rancher-desktop.internal); Rancher Desktop resolves both.

msg: gateway.docker.internal is a Docker Desktop VM host name.
fix: To reach a service on your machine use host.docker.internal or host.rancher-desktop.internal.

msg: This line installs Docker Desktop, which needs a paid subscription at companies with 250+ employees or US $10,000,000+ annual revenue.
fix: Install Rancher Desktop instead: brew install --cask rancher on macOS, or the installer from the Rancher Desktop GitHub releases page.

msg: This line starts the Docker Desktop app.
fix: Start Rancher Desktop instead: rdctl start (or open -a "Rancher Desktop").

msg: Setup text tells people to use Docker Desktop. Free use ends at 250 employees or US $10,000,000 revenue; government entities always need a subscription.
fix: Name Rancher Desktop (dockerd/moby engine, so the docker CLI and docker compose keep working) as the free setup.
